text:
maria: Finalizing the 5-email welcome series for the launch. Question: should we split by lead_score or keep a single funnel? Thinking lead_score >=70 get 'fast' cadence (days 0,2,5), others get slower (0,4,10). Thoughts? @alex @josh
alex: I vote split. High score people expect faster cadence. Also propose excluding anyone who signed up for the webinar in the last 30 days.
josh: Agree. Ops note: if we split, need routing rule in Braze (or SFMC) and ensure suppression for 'webinar_attendee' tag. I'll handle routing if we finalize thresholds.
olivia: Subject line variants: high-score = "Quick start w/ Redwood Inference — your credits inside", low-score = "Welcome — tips to get started + credits". Can make hero gif for high-score.
maria: Nice. A/B for subject lines? 20% sample each.
alex: 20% sounds good. Also let's track lead_score bucket in utm_campaign param (utm_campaign=welcome_v1&segment=high|low).
campaign-bot: Scheduled send preview created: campaign/welcome_launch_preview (preview link: https://app.campaigns.redwood.ai/preview/12345).
maria: Perfect. Josh, can you add suppression for 'recent_webinar_30d' and 'support_ticket_open'?
josh: On it, ETA 2pm PT. Also adding engagement rule: if unsub or bounce -> stop sequence.
maria: Great. Last thing: dataset for evaluation — can we get conversion lift metric by segment at day 14? @alex
alex: Yes, I'll set up a Looker dashboard; should be ready Mon. I'll post link.
olivia: I'll upload hero assets to the Notion page: https://redwood.notion.site/Welcome-Campaign-Assets-abcdef
maria: Thanks team! :rocket:
